adjudication.evidence: P1 (526–528) coincides with a single missing sample at 527 and shows no sustained shift or return in N/E/U; interior values are inconsistent with a platform. P2 (532–539) aligns with a large, abrupt offset (~-9 to -15 mm in N, ~-6 mm in E, ~+6 mm in U) beginning at index 532 and persisting through 539, followed by a clear return toward pre-offset levels by index 540–541 (e.g., N jumps from -13.4 to -4.6, E from -5.9 to -1.7, U from ~6 to ~0.2). This satisfies the definition of a temporary offset: sustained shift across all axes followed by opposing return. No other candidate intervals show such behavior.
